files.description: Check the alignment between code changes in the specified scope and architecture decisions.
Scan the codebase and generate or refresh `.ai-skills/architecture.md`, recording architecture decisions that should not be broken during code changes.
Promote a skill to the global repository so it can be distributed to any project via `/aisk/sync`.
Configure a new project to work with globally installed aisk skills.
Walk through the code implemented in the current Phase, grouped by layer, to help understand design decisions and implementation details.
Organize the `.claude/settings.local.json` permission configuration for the current project.
Iteratively review and fix a specified file, module, or directory.
Verify task completion, clean up task documents, and prompt the user to create a PR.
Initialize a new Task: create branch, scaffold task documents, and enter work mode.
Alias for `start-task` — enter task work mode for the current session.
Enter task work mode for the current session. `resume-task` is an alias with identical behavior.
Run acceptance checks for a single step. Defaults to the current step.
Run acceptance checks across all steps of the current task.
Create a new walkthrough: checkout the target version, analyze all changes in one pass, pre-generate group content, then present group by group.
Alias for `start-walkthrough` — resume a walkthrough from the state file.
Resume a walkthrough from the state file. `resume-walkthrough` is an alias with identical behavior.
